description:
A basic 2-winding transformer.

The model uses an equivalent circuit assuming the impedance is on the High Voltage Side of the transformer. The model allocates the iron losses and magnetizing susceptance to the primary side.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

active_power_flow.description: Initial condition of active power flow through the transformer. Units: MW.

reactive_power_flow.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow through the transformer. Units: MVAr.

arc.description: An Arc defining this transformer `from` a bus `to` another bus.

r.description: Resistance. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

x.description: Reactance. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

primary_shunt.description: Primary shunt admittance. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

rating.description: Thermal rating. Flow through the transformer must be between -`rating` and `rating`. Units: MVA.

base_power.description: Base power of the unit for per unitization. Units: MVA.

base_voltage_primary.description: Primary base voltage. default of get_base_voltage(get_from(arc))) Units: kV.

base_voltage_secondary.description: Secondary base voltage. default of get_base_voltage(get_to(arc))) Units: kV.

winding_group_number.description: Vector group number ('clock number') indicating phase shift between the `from` and `to` buses.

title: Transformer2W
